title: DRAEVIK Devlog — 20 days of building a dark fantasy ARPG with AI agents
author: Badcatrb
selftext:
Hey everyone,

I'm a solo developer working on DRAEVIK, a dark fantasy ARPG built with Godot 4 and AI agents.

I'm a software developer by background, not a game dev. I started this project to experiment with AI-assisted game development, and it's been about 20 days since I began.

The game now has a six-act campaign, different character builds, a passive skill tree, crafting, boss fights, online multiplayer, and endgame systems like Realms and the Endless Tower.

I've been using AI coding agents throughout development, along with tools like PixelLab and image generation for pixel art and UI. Some of the audio is AI-generated as well.

A small group of players has already started playtesting the game, which has been pretty interesting to see.

The clip is a short showcase of a few builds and systems using test characters.

Just wanted to share a bit of what I've been working on.
